messages.content: What is the time now in New York City?

function.name: calculate_sunrise_and_sunset
function.description: Calculate the sunrise and sunset time of a location for the given date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location in city, state format.

date.description: The date for which the sunrise and sunset needs to be calculated in yyyy-mm-dd format.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time data, so I can’t tell you the exact current time in New York City right now. However, if you let me know your current time zone or the UTC time, I can help you calculate what time it would be in New York (which is typically UTC−5 during standard time and UTC−4 during daylight saving time).
message.reasoning: The user asks for current time in NYC. We can provide approximate or we can use function to get sunrise/sunset but not needed. We can answer with local time. But we don't have real-time data. We can approximate based on UTC offset. But better to say we cannot provide real-time. We can give approximate if we know current UTC. But we don't have current time. So we should respond that we can't provide real-time.
